item.title: Justin Rose delivers a Tiger-like performance at Torrey Pines. He leads by 6 shots
item.description: Justin Rose delivered a performance Saturday at Torrey Pines that Tiger Woods could appreciate, stretching his lead to as many as eight shots until a few late mistakes led to a 4-under 68 for a five-stroke lead in the Farmers Insurance Open.

item.title: Senior Bowl: Nussmeier leads 2 scoring drives as American beats National, 17-9
item.description: LSU quarterback Garrett Nussmeier led a pair of touchdown drives as the American team beat the National team in the Senior Bowl.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn sits out final race before Olympics but remains on track after crash
item.description: Lindsey Vonn is sitting out a World Cup super-G race after crashing and injuring her left knee but remains on track for the Olympics.

item.title: Demonstrators in Milan protest ICE unit at Winter Olympics
item.description: Hundreds of demonstrators gathered Saturday in Milan to protest the deployment of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents during the Winter Olympics.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 01, 2026
item.description: Small choices reveal big needs for balance. Initially, the emotional Moon opposes transformative Pluto, so we may swing between personal wants and collective expectations until we slow down. By the Full Moon in Leo at 5:09 pm EST, we can name what our hearts want and show it clearly and respectfully. We may need to set up some rules for continuing conversations, but creativity is still the focal point. Trying something new and being wrong is better than not having tried it at all!

item.title: Cold-related deaths continue to climb in Maryland
item.description: Across the state of Maryland, 27 people have died from hypothermia so far this season, according to the Maryland Department of Health.

item.title: Navy men’s basketball beats Loyola Maryland, 87-71, to continue strong start
item.description: Aidan Kehoe scored 23 points on 11-for-11 shooting as Navy rolled to a win over Loyola Maryland to continue its best start since 2000.

item.title: No. 16 Maryland women’s basketball suffers 4th straight loss, 68-61 to Oregon
item.description: Maryland women's basketball suffered its fourth straight loss and sixth in the past nine games on Saturday.

item.title: New Epstein files include emails between LA Olympics leader Wasserman and Ghislaine Maxwell
item.description: Casey Wasserman, the head of the Los Angeles Olympics organizing committee, is named in the latest collection of government files released on Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: ESPN closes deal for NFL Network, rights for RedZone which gives the NFL a stake in the network
item.description: ESPN’s purchase of NFL Network and other league digital assets has been finalized after government regulators approved the transaction.
